text:
Ava (People Ops): quick q for parents and managers — can people expense pump rental/shipping while on parental leave if they're traveling for a medical appointment? wondering if we should include guidance in the leave checklist :thinking_face:
Jon W: @Ava good question. team member is traveling for a consult and wants to rent a pump locally instead of shipping their own. is that an approved expense?
Ava (People Ops): short answer: yes in most cases. long answer: we cover reasonable lactation-related expenses tied to leave or return-to-work visits (pump rental, storage, shipping of pump, replacement parts). need receipts and manager/PO signoff.
Ria: tagging because i'm about to book travel and want to avoid an unexpected bill — any dollar cap or vendor list?
Ava (People Ops): no strict vendor list. recommended max is $500 for one-off rentals/shipments; exceptions OK if manager + People Ops approve. please submit under expense category `Lactation & Family Supplies` and attach receipts.
Ben S: i did this last year — manager approved, submitted receipt + proof of appointment, finance reimbursed within 2 pay cycles. easiest path was Concur, but Expensify also works.
HR-Bot: New policy doc uploaded: https://intranet.redwood/care/parental-resources#lactation — includes sample receipts and a short checklist.
Ria: thanks! can you paste the minimal required fields for the expense so i don't miss anything?
Ava (People Ops): sure — include these in the expense submission:
```
Expense Type: Lactation & Family Supplies
Amount: $XXX.XX
Date of purchase/rental
Vendor name
Receipt (PDF/JPG)
Reason: travel for medical appointment / parental leave
Manager approver: <manager name>
```
Ava (People Ops): if shipping a pump back/forth, add tracking number and note whether the pump is personal or company-provided. if it's company-provided equipment, route through IT first.
Jon W: good to know. i'll add a blurb to the return-to-work checklist we send to ICs.
Ria: appreciated — will submit once i have the rental confirmation. :thumbsup:
Ava (People Ops): thanks all — ping me if you want People Ops to pre-approve before booking (saves time).
